closest_to_revenue_pain: paid preflight/black-box review for a concrete agent action before client/customer/system exposure

fractures.what_is_breaking: Agents can act through tools before organizations can prove whether the action should be allowed.
fractures.why_existing_approaches_insufficient: Observability records what happened; GRC states policy; frameworks execute tools. Few connect intent, evidence, authorization, replay, feedback, and business route.
fractures.why_now: MCP/A2A/AP2/tool-call ecosystems make action, delegation, and commerce concrete.
fractures.willingness_to_pay_proxy: agent governance, audit, readiness, and platform pricing categories exist, but no Y* willingness-to-pay proof yet

fractures.what_is_breaking: Organizations cannot easily reconstruct why an agent acted, what evidence it had, what it touched, and how learning should update.
fractures.why_existing_approaches_insufficient: Traces are not the same as legitimacy or business learning.
fractures.why_now: Agent runs now include tool calls, handoffs, and protocol-mediated tasks.
fractures.willingness_to_pay_proxy: observability and GRC products show budget categories

fractures.what_is_breaking: Human-centric IAM and approval systems strain when non-human agents act continuously and chain permissions.
fractures.why_existing_approaches_insufficient: Identity inventory does not alone determine action legitimacy or learning boundaries.
fractures.why_now: Enterprise agents and agentic governance vendors are emerging around discovery and permissions.

fractures.what_is_breaking: Demos and readiness claims can look persuasive without evidence, receipts, or real feedback.
fractures.why_existing_approaches_insufficient: Consulting narratives and product dashboards can obscure whether real action and learning occurred.
fractures.why_now: Agent adoption pressure rewards demos faster than proof.
fractures.willingness_to_pay_proxy: readiness diagnostics and audits already sell around trust and risk

institutional_void: No widely understood business layer connects intent, evidence, authorization, execution containment, receipts, feedback, learning, and commercial route for agent actions.
most_strategically_compounding_pain: institutional action-trust layer for agentic systems
strongest_near_term_buyer: AI consultancies and enterprise AI/security operators preparing client or internal agent deployments.
urgent_buyer_pain: Teams want to deploy agents but cannot prove which actions are safe, authorized, evidenced, auditable, and worth learning from.
